text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Guh, it frustrates me every time I 
remember it! Losing in speed, of all 
things!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Are you really that frustrated just 
because you woke up after the alarm went 
off?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I mean, that's totally normal, isn't it? 
That's what alarms are for—to wake you up.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
At all times, in any moment, the fastest 
is me. Tomorrow, I will surpass him for 
sure!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I told you, just listen to me!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Well, make sure you go to 
bed early tonight. No staying up late.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Time to snooze at top 
speed—aaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Wild Animal TV! Cute Kitty Cats 3-Hour 
Special"?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That's my reason for living, I can't miss 
it... But then I'll lose top speed!! Kitty 
cat, alarm clock, kitty caaaaat!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for goodness' sake, calm down! 
Look...! It says the special episode has a 
replay stream.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I have no reason to lose anymore. 
Thank you, Durandal. I will definitely win 
tomorrow!
